hardening.minimized_reason: Build OpenSSH without PAM, SELinux, zlib compression or PKCS#11 support; OpenSSL stays for P-256 security keys.
hardening.pledge_reason: No package-enforced pledge-style capability policy is claimed; sshd confinement is declared in the Werewolf sshd forms.

changes.what: Configure --without-pam --without-selinux --without-zlib --disable-pkcs11 and drop their build dependencies.
changes.why: Werewolf runs sshd with UsePAM no on a kernel without SELinux; these libraries were only code mapped into root, network-facing processes. Compression and agent PKCS#11 support carried OpenSSH's own bugs.
It configures PAM for a server built without it.

wolfi.removal_condition: Wolfi ships equivalent build options and installed-package probes verify them; review before retiring this overlay.
